shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: Separate court cards from the paper background.

shadows.name: session-anchor
shadows.purpose: Anchor the player’s current session status.

components.name: Your session
components.description: The player-first recording summary shown before the complete court list.
components.css: .your-session { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; padding:15px 16px; border-radius:14px; color:#fff; background:#16392d; box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(22,57,45,.16); }

narrative.overview: A practical, daylight-readable venue system that makes the player’s own recording unmistakable before handing off to the dark reel viewer.

rules.name: The Current Session Rule
rules.body: Show court and end time before the full list whenever the player owns a live session.

dos: Use Court Green for primary action and active navigation.
Use text together with every status color.
donts: Do not use low-contrast metadata for primary task cues.
Do not make sensitive settings look auto-saved when they are not.
